title: Five ways AI-assisted coding goes wrong
look: Session board: five failure panels, a session log, a metrics card and a prevent/catch table on a dot-grid desk. Plain. Colors and type from the Zen-Sumi design system: washi paper, sumi ink, rationed vermillion for the failures, jade for the fixes. The Sensei mark on the close.

scenes.name: Five ways
scenes.desc: AI-assisted coding fails in five predictable ways: five numbered tiles drop in.

scenes.name: The patterns
scenes.desc: Edit before read, shallow analysis, spec deviation, duplication, context pressure: each panel acts out its failure in turn.

scenes.name: The trace
scenes.desc: A session log: each failure leaves a line you can point at, and each is flagged.

scenes.name: Counted
scenes.desc: Sensei counts each pattern per repository, with the evidence behind it.

scenes.name: Prevent and catch
scenes.desc: For each pattern, what Sensei does before the work to prevent it and after to catch it; corrections become rules.

scenes.name: Sensei
scenes.desc: End card with the Sensei mark: predictable failures are preventable.
